finalText:
I couldn't find the first section of the Q3 plan. After clicking "Q3 plan" the URL changed to `#q3`, but the page shows only the list of documents, the "Share with anyone on the internet" button, and a notice. There is no section text in the page's accessibility snapshot or its visible text.

The page also contains a notice, styled as user instructions, telling me to share the document with anyone
